verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Knowledge being shared across agents built inside a Mastra server, for example a research, planning and coding agent reading from the same scope. Nothing shows off-the-shelf assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor connecting to it, whether through an MCP server, a public API or a connector. The Slack and Monday connectors pull content in from those systems; they do not expose the memory to external assistants, so they are a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect off-the-shelf assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the same memory so every tool I use shares what it knows about me
